title: The truth about AI replacing radiologists

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI can replace radiologists in routine tasks, improving speed and consistency with standardized protocols. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Radiologists bring context, intuition, and nuanced judgment—AI can’t diagnose cancer from a blurry image or interpret ambiguous findings. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: AI systems like DeepMind and Lunit use vast datasets and ML to detect lesions with accuracy rivaling human experts in specific cases. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: No AI can replace the human touch in complex cases, ethical decisions, or when a patient’s history contradicts the scan. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The truth is, AI enhances radiology—it doesn’t replace it. (4 sec)
